### National Ignition Facility Experiment Exceeds Target Energy Input

The National Ignition Facility experiment achieved fusion ignition, producing 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy after 2.05 megajoules were delivered to the target. On this target-level comparison, fusion output exceeded the energy delivered to the target.

The result is treated as progress toward inertial fusion energy, not as practical electricity production. Practical energy production still requires substantial scientific and technological development.
